posts.hook: an AI lab says it just cracked a famous computer science assumption
posts.caption: openai claims a proof that the exponential time hypothesis is false, cloudflare discloses a model leaked other customers' prompts, broadcom lines up $63b to fund anthropic's chips. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: OpenAI says its models found a proof that the ==Exponential Time Hypothesis== is false
slides.desc: A claim, not yet a result: experts still have to check the preprint

terms.gloss: a guess that hard problems can't beat brute force by much

slides.title: Cloudflare's GLM-5.3 model leaked other customers' data in 155 responses
slides.desc: A cache pool smaller than the context window plus an engine bug left stale data in place

terms.gloss: the memory a model keeps of the prompts it is processing

slides.title: Broadcom arranges $63B to finance the chips Anthropic is buying
slides.desc: The chip supplier is now part of the group lending for its own sale

slides.title: Siri in iOS 27.2 can recall your past conversations
slides.desc: It also reaches voicemails and Messages attachments when answering

slides.title: China's Star 50 AI and chip index is down 40% in under four months
slides.desc: About $480B of market value gone on AI demand worries and export curbs

terms.gloss: china's index of its leading AI and chip stocks

posts.hook: a second AI lab says it broke the same math barrier
posts.caption: anthropic publishes lean proofs for its own claim that the exponential time hypothesis is false, two senators say a secret court ruling on surveillance searches is being withheld, nvidia puts $3b into meta's stock raise. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Anthropic publishes Lean proofs for its own claim that the ==Exponential Time Hypothesis== is false
slides.desc: Nothing machine-checks that the Lean statements match the paper, so humans still decide

terms.gloss: a proof language whose checker verifies each step by machine

slides.title: Two senators say the US is withholding a secret court ruling on warrantless searches
slides.desc: The release window closed Sept 13 while officials push to renew ==Section 702==

terms.gloss: the US spy law behind collecting foreign targets' messages

slides.title: Nvidia puts $3B into Meta's stock raise, part of up to $95B Meta is seeking
slides.desc: The chip seller is again funding its own buyer

slides.title: Google's AI bug hunter found 45 flaws in Chrome's JavaScript engine in six months, a fuzzer 37
slides.desc: Only 25% overlapped, so neither tool replaces the other

terms.gloss: a tool that feeds programs random inputs to make them crash

slides.title: Google launches Genie 4, a world model that generates interactive simulations
slides.desc: It adds audio, and starts as a preview for trusted testers only

terms.gloss: an ai that simulates a place you can steer in real time
